plivo auth token mint — POST /v1/agent/token.

Available modules:
  number.read, number.write
  application.read, application.write
  message.read, message.send
  call.read, call.make
  agent.read, agent.write
  *   (full access — use sparingly)

TTL accepts Go-style durations plus 'd' for days: 30m, 1h, 6h, 24h, 7d.

Example:
  plivo auth token mint --modules number.read,message.send --ttl 1h --label "demo"

Usage:
  plivo auth token mint [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help             help for mint
      --label string     human-readable label attached to the token
      --modules string   comma-separated module scopes (required) — e.g. number.read,message.send
      --ttl string       token lifetime: 30m, 1h, 6h, 24h, 7d (Go ParseDuration + 'd' suffix) (default "1h")

Global Flags:
      --all                        auto-paginate through all pages
      --dry-run                    print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain                    explain what the command will do before executing
      --hodor-server plivo agent   base URL for hodor (used by plivo agent and `plivo auth token`)
      --log-level string           log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color                   disable colored output
  -o, --output string              output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string             named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet                      suppress non-data output
      --timeout int                request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                        skip confirmation prompts
